remarks: Searching for a rental home? This inviting 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence in the Carriage House offers comfort, space, and scenic views of the Five Mile River. Filled with natural light, this well-maintained home features an open-concept layout that connects the living and dining areas, creating an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The generously sized kitchen is thoughtfully designed with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, ample counter space, and abundant cabinetry. The primary suite provides a relaxing retreat with a private en-suite bathroom and a spacious walk-in closet. A second bedroom and full bathroom offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space. Additional features include a reserved parking space, ample visitor parking, and elevator access. Set in a charming, park-like environment, the Carriage House offers a peaceful riverside lifestyle. Conveniently located near I-95 and Metro-North stations in Rowayton and Darien, with an easy commute to New York City of approximately 55 minutes.
